description: SHALL and SHOULD assignments for the medical MVP technical specification of the CMS Health Tech Ecosystem Real-Time Benefits workgroup, mapped to Benefit Plan Standard documents written by the 2 public-file importers. One entry per item. scripts/build-rtb-dictionary.js reads this file with the 2 importer crosswalks and the canonical benefit vocabulary and writes data-dictionary.md in this folder.
attribution: The assignments follow the workgroup's medical MVP scope (Monica Chopra's pledge proposal, October 2026). Service and benefit names are the scope's suggested names; every other text in this file was written for the Benefit Plan Standard and is not the workgroup's wording.

labels.SHALL: Required for the MVP. A pledgee makes the item available to the member on request, wherever it applies to the member's plan.
labels.SHOULD: Optional for the MVP. It may become SHALL at GA.
labels.KEY: The identifier an app uses to find the plan's document. Not an item shown to the member.

medicare_advantage.name: Medicare Advantage
reading: Each service category has its own columns in its own file, 1 row per plan. A Medicare-covered category is covered on every plan; when both its copay and coinsurance answers are No, the Medicare Advantage importer writes a $0 copay step and quotes both answers.
Minimum and maximum columns become a range (amount_min and amount_max, rate_min and rate_max) when they differ.
Every tier row quotes, in its notes, the cells it was read from.

cost.note: The included-or-optional column sets coverage_basis (2 mandatory, 3 optional; 4, both, is written null with a note). Authorization and referral answers go to conditions[].

limits.note: A quantity limit reads the unlimited-or-limited answer (1 unlimited, 2 limited), the number and the period. A dollar maximum reads the maximum plan benefit columns; a maximum shared with another category carries a shared_limit_id.

marketplace.name: Marketplace
marketplace.files: CMS Health Insurance Exchange public use files (PUFs)
reading: Every benefit is a row of benefits-and-cost-sharing-puf.csv with the same columns, found by its exact BenefitName and the plan's PlanId.
Costs are text, such as "$30.00" or "20.00% Coinsurance after deductible". The Marketplace importer reads each string into a copay or coinsurance step and quotes both strings in the tier's notes.
IsCovered applies to the whole benefit, so every tier row of a benefit carries the same covered value.

covered.note: IsCovered "Covered" is covered true on every tier; "Not Covered" or blank is covered false.

cost.note: Exclusions and Explanation go to conditions[] as types exclusion and explanation. IsExclFromInnMOOP and IsExclFromOonMOOP set applies_to_moop.
cost.not_in_file: The Benefits and Cost Sharing PUF has no column for whether a benefit is included or an optional add-on, and none for authorization or referral, so these rows carry neither.

limits.note: A dollar limit is a LimitUnit that starts with Dollars, with the amount in LimitQty. QuantLimitOnSvc is not carried; limits[] implies it.

groups.title: Plan key, plan year and date of the data
groups.intro: How an app finds the plan's document, and the 2 facts the scope asks for on every answer: the plan year and the date of the CMS data.

groups.title: Plan-level fields
groups.intro: Fields that apply to the whole plan. Each is asked for wherever it applies to the member's plan; special needs plan fields, for example, apply only to special needs plans.

groups.title: Network items (use case 2)
groups.intro: Whether the cost changes with where the member goes: in or out of network, the out-of-network deductible and maximum, the provider directory, and the second in-network tier where a Marketplace plan has one.

groups.title: Services with a cost
groups.intro: Each row is the member's in-network cost for 1 service. The out-of-network cost of the same service is the network item "Out-of-network cost for each service".

groups.title: The extra benefits
groups.intro: Benefits a plan may or may not offer. Whether the plan covers the benefit is SHALL; its cost and conditions and its limits are SHOULD. Limits are SHOULD because use case 3 has no SHALL in the MVP: a known gap, to revisit for GA.

aspects.title: covered or not
aspects.label: SHALL
aspects.meaning: Whether the plan covers this benefit.

aspects.title: cost and details
aspects.label: SHOULD
aspects.meaning: What the member pays for this benefit, and the conditions the plan files with it.

aspects.title: limits
aspects.label: SHOULD
aspects.meaning: How many, how often or how much of this benefit the plan covers.

gaps.title: Medicare Advantage physical therapy and speech therapy (category 7i) has no canonical key.
gaps.instead: The Medicare Advantage importer writes the benefit by name: benefit_id PHYSICAL_AND_SPEECH_THERAPY, with service_name and raw_label and no canonical_key. The Benefit Plan Standard canonical benefit vocabulary has keys for physical therapy, for speech therapy and for physical with occupational therapy, but none for this pair.
gaps.closed_by: The canonical benefit vocabulary has the key physical_and_speech_therapy (version 1.3.0), and the Medicare Advantage importer writes category 7i with it.

gaps.title: Medicare Advantage preventive services (category 14a) are not read.
gaps.instead: The Medicare Advantage importer writes no preventive_care benefit for a Medicare Advantage plan. The plan's answer is in pbp_b14a_mc_prevent_attest in pbp_b14_preventive.txt.
gaps.closed_by: The Medicare Advantage importer reads category 14a into a preventive_care benefit: a $0 copay in network on the plan's attestation, pbp_b14a_mc_prevent_attest, and the out-of-network and point-of-service cost from the Section C groups that list 14a.

gaps.title: Medicare Advantage monthly premium and Part B premium reduction are not read.
gaps.instead: The Benefit Plan Standard schema 1.2.0 has the premium and part_b_premium_reduction fields, but the Medicare Advantage importer reads neither pbp_d_mplusc_premium nor pbp_d_mco_pay_reduct_yn and pbp_d_mco_pay_reduct_amt in pbp_Section_D.txt, so a document has neither field.
gaps.closed_by: The Medicare Advantage importer writes premium from pbp_d_mplusc_premium and part_b_premium_reduction from pbp_d_mco_pay_reduct_yn and pbp_d_mco_pay_reduct_amt; a blank premium writes none, and a reduction answered No writes none and is quoted.

gaps.title: Medicare Advantage member services phone is not read.
gaps.instead: The Medicare Advantage importer does not read pbp_a_curmbr_phone in pbp_Section_A.txt, and the Benefit Plan Standard schema 1.2.0 has no field for a phone number. The plan website, pbp_a_org_website, is quoted verbatim in source_references.
gaps.closed_by: The Benefit Plan Standard schema 1.2.0 draft has contacts. The Medicare Advantage importer writes contacts.member_services_phone from pbp_a_curmbr_phone, and contacts.website from pbp_a_org_website when the address is a URI with its scheme; an address without one is quoted.

gaps.title: The provider directory link has no field.
gaps.instead: Schema 1.2.0 has no field for it. The Medicare Advantage importer quotes pbp_a_phys_web_addr and pbp_a_org_website verbatim in source_references. The Marketplace importer does not read the Network PUF, so NetworkURL is not carried; the plan's NetworkId from the Plan Attributes PUF is quoted.
gaps.closed_by: The Benefit Plan Standard schema 1.2.0 draft has network_tiers[].provider_directory_url. The Medicare Advantage importer writes it on the in-network tier from pbp_a_phys_web_addr when the address is a URI with its scheme, and the Marketplace importer from NetworkURL in the Network PUF, the row whose BusinessYear, StateCode, IssuerId, NetworkId and MarketCoverage are the plan's.

gaps.title: Marketplace ImportDate is not carried.
gaps.instead: Both files the Marketplace importer reads have an ImportDate column. The Marketplace importer writes the date the files were downloaded, from data/puf/<year>/download.json, in the first source_references excerpt.
gaps.closed_by: The Marketplace importer quotes each file's ImportDate in the first source_references excerpt, beside the download dates.

gaps.title: Marketplace documents have no plan_identifiers.
gaps.instead: The Marketplace importer writes schema 1.1.0, which has no plan_identifiers. The HIOS plan id with its 2-digit variant (for example 68398FL0030058-01) appears only as text inside the first source_references excerpt.
gaps.closed_by: The Marketplace importer writes Benefit Plan Standard schema 1.2.0, with plan_identifiers hios_plan_id (for example 68398FL0030058-01) and hios_id (68398FL0030058).

gaps.title: Marketplace out-of-area coverage descriptions are not read.
gaps.instead: The Marketplace importer quotes the Yes or No answers, OutOfServiceAreaCoverage and OutOfCountryCoverage, in source_references. It does not read OutOfServiceAreaCoverageDescription or OutOfCountryCoverageDescription in the Plan Attributes PUF, so the plan's own description of that coverage is not in the document, and no field is written for it.
gaps.closed_by: The Marketplace importer quotes OutOfServiceAreaCoverageDescription and OutOfCountryCoverageDescription in source_references when they are filled.

items.name: Plan key
items.meaning: The identifier an app uses to pick out the plan's document.

medicare_advantage.label: KEY
medicare_advantage.note: Written as contract, plan and segment with the segment padded to 3 digits, for example H1609-028-000. The file's own bid_id column writes the same key as H1609_028_0 and is quoted in source_references. The contract alone is also written, with system cms_contract_id (H1609), and the plan alone, with system cms_pbp_id (028).

marketplace.label: KEY
marketplace.note: The 14-character HIOS plan id and the 2-digit variant, for example 68398FL0030058-01. Each cost-sharing reduction variant is its own plan with its own costs. The 14-character id alone, StandardComponentId, is also written, with system hios_id.

items.name: Plan year
items.meaning: The year the plan's benefits apply to.

medicare_advantage.label: SHALL
medicare_advantage.note: Section A has no year column. The Medicare Advantage importer reads contract_year from the plan's service area rows and requires it to equal the release year.

items.name: Date of the CMS data
items.meaning: Which release of the CMS data an answer comes from, and when it was downloaded.

medicare_advantage.label: SHALL
medicare_advantage.note: The excerpt names the release, for example "PBP Benefits-2027", and the download date. The zip's Last-Modified date stays in download.json and is not in the document.

marketplace.label: SHALL
marketplace.note: The excerpt names the 3 files with their download addresses and download dates, the Network PUF's own date when download.json gives it one in downloaded_files, and each file's ImportDate as the file writes it, for example "10/15/2025" in the Plan Attributes PUF and "2025-10-15" in the other 2.

items.name: Coverage dates
items.meaning: The first and last dates of the plan's coverage.

medicare_advantage.not_in_file: No PBP file has a date column. The Medicare Advantage importer writes plan_year only.

marketplace.label: SHALL
marketplace.note: Written as ISO dates. expiry_date is left out when PlanExpirationDate is blank.

items.name: Plan name
items.meaning: The plan's marketing name.

marketplace.label: SHALL
marketplace.note: plan_name is PlanMarketingName. PlanVariantMarketingName, the name of the cost-sharing reduction variant, is quoted in source_references.

items.name: Insurer name
items.meaning: The name of the insurer that offers the plan.

medicare_advantage.label: SHALL
medicare_advantage.note: The document's carrier is the marketing name. The legal name, pbp_a_org_name, is quoted in source_references.

items.name: Plan type
items.meaning: The kind of plan, such as HMO or PPO.

medicare_advantage.label: SHALL
medicare_advantage.note: Codes 01, 02, 04 and 31 are written HMO, HMO_POS, PPO and PPO, and the code and its label are quoted in source_references. The Medicare Advantage importer refuses other plan types.

marketplace.label: SHALL
marketplace.note: Written as the file gives it, except that Indemnity becomes INDEMNITY.

items.name: Special needs plan and type
items.meaning: Whether the plan is a special needs plan, and of which type.

items.name: Metal level
items.meaning: The plan's metal level, such as Bronze, Silver or Gold.

items.name: Cost-sharing reduction variant
items.meaning: Which cost-sharing reduction variant of the plan this is; each variant has its own costs.

items.name: Monthly plan premium
items.meaning: What the member pays the plan each month.

medicare_advantage.label: SHALL
medicare_advantage.note: premium.amount, in USD, is pbp_d_mplusc_premium, "Plan Premium Amount (A/B)". No CMS file or dictionary text states the period, so premium.period is not written. A blank premium writes none (1,362 of the 6,872 plans in contract year 2027). pbp_d_mplusc_bonly_premium, "Plan Premium Amount (B Only)", is quoted when filled (45 plans).

marketplace.not_in_file: Neither file the Marketplace importer reads has a premium column; premiums vary by age and area and are in the Rate PUF, which the Marketplace importer does not read. The Marketplace importer writes no premium.

items.name: Part B premium reduction
items.meaning: How much the plan lowers the member's Medicare Part B premium.

medicare_advantage.label: SHALL
medicare_advantage.note: pbp_d_mco_pay_reduct_yn 1 writes part_b_premium_reduction.amount from pbp_d_mco_pay_reduct_amt (1,412 plans); 2, No, writes nothing, and the answer is quoted in source_references. No period is stated.

items.name: Deductible
items.meaning: What the member pays in network before the plan starts to share costs.

medicare_advantage.label: SHALL
medicare_advantage.note: HMO and HMO-POS plans use the in-network columns and PPOs the annual ones; a PPO's network_tier is IN, null or OUT by the deductible's scope (importer spec section 4.3). A Medicare-defined deductible has no amount in the file, so no slot is written and the answer is quoted in source_references. Section D has no family amounts.

marketplace.label: SHALL
marketplace.note: TEHB columns (medical and drug together) when MedicalDrugDeductiblesIntegrated is Yes, otherwise MEHB (medical); applies_to says which. The family slot takes the per-group amount, and embedded says whether a per-person amount applies inside it.

items.name: Drug deductible, when separate
items.meaning: The prescription drug deductible of a plan that keeps it apart from the medical deductible.

marketplace.label: SHALL
marketplace.note: Part of the deductible item when MedicalDrugDeductiblesIntegrated is No. Benefit Plan Standard schema 1.1.0 had no pharmacy accumulator; since 2026-10-20 the Marketplace importer writes Benefit Plan Standard schema 1.2.0, whose pharmacy.deductible could hold the amount (see README, Follow-ups).

items.name: Out-of-pocket maximum
items.meaning: The most the member pays in network for covered services before the plan pays in full.

medicare_advantage.label: SHALL
medicare_advantage.note: The maximum's type in pbp_d_out_pocket_amt_type (lower, intermediate or mandatory) is quoted in source_references. Section D has no family amounts.

marketplace.label: SHALL
marketplace.note: MEHB columns in place of TEHB when MedicalDrugMaximumOutofPocketIntegrated is No, as for the deductible.

items.name: Member services phone and website
items.meaning: How the member reaches the plan.

medicare_advantage.label: SHALL
medicare_advantage.note: pbp_a_curmbr_phone is the customer service number for current members, filled on all 6,872 plans; the number for people who want to join is not read. contacts.website is written only when pbp_a_org_website is a URI with its scheme (457 plans); otherwise the address is quoted in source_references, because the Benefit Plan Standard schema field is a URI and the Medicare Advantage importer adds no scheme.

marketplace.note: None of the Plan Attributes PUF's 4 addresses (the SBC, the brochure, the drug list and the payment page) is a plan website, so the Marketplace importer writes no contacts; the 4 are quoted in source_references.

items.name: Health savings account eligible
items.meaning: Whether the plan can be paired with a health savings account.

items.name: Referral needed to see a specialist
items.meaning: Whether the member needs a referral to see a specialist, and for which specialists.

medicare_advantage.note: The PBP files hold referral answers per service category instead (for example pbp_b7d_refer_yn), which the Medicare Advantage importer writes as conditions on the benefit.

items.name: Plan-wide exclusions
items.meaning: What the plan excludes, in the insurer's own words.

items.name: Links to the SBC, brochure and drug list
items.meaning: Web addresses of the plan's Summary of Benefits and Coverage, brochure and drug list.

items.name: Employer group plan flag
items.meaning: Whether the plan is offered only through employers or unions.

items.name: Out-of-network coverage
items.meaning: Whether the plan pays for care outside its network.

medicare_advantage.label: SHALL
medicare_advantage.note: An OUT tier is written when pbp_c_oon_yn is 1 (PPOs) and a POS tier when pbp_c_pos_yn is 1 (HMO-POS plans); HMOs have neither. A benefit has an OUT or POS row only when a group in pbp_Section_C_OON.txt or pbp_Section_C_POS.txt lists its category.

marketplace.label: SHALL
marketplace.note: Every document has an OUT tier. Whether a service is covered out of network follows the benefit's IsCovered.

items.name: Out-of-network cost for each service
items.meaning: What the member pays for a service outside the network.

medicare_advantage.label: SHALL
medicare_advantage.note: 1 row per group of services; a benefit takes the cost of the group whose list names its category. Inpatient and skilled nursing stays out of network come from pbp_Section_C.txt instead.

items.name: Point-of-service cost
items.meaning: What a member of an HMO with a point-of-service option pays outside the network.

medicare_advantage.label: SHALL
medicare_advantage.note: The same layout as the out-of-network groups, under other column names. Applies to HMO-POS plans only.

items.name: Out-of-network deductible
items.meaning: What the member pays outside the network before the plan shares costs there.

medicare_advantage.label: SHALL
medicare_advantage.note: On HMO-POS plans the slot's network_tier is POS. On a PPO whose annual deductible names no in-network scope, the annual deductible is written here with network_tier OUT (importer spec section 4.3).

marketplace.label: SHALL
marketplace.note: MEHB columns in place of TEHB when the deductibles are not integrated, as in network.

items.name: Out-of-network out-of-pocket maximum
items.meaning: The most the member pays outside the network before the plan pays in full.

medicare_advantage.label: SHALL
medicare_advantage.note: network_tier is OUT on PPOs and POS on HMO-POS plans.

items.name: Combined in- and out-of-network deductible and maximum
items.meaning: A deductible or maximum that counts in-network and out-of-network spending together.

medicare_advantage.label: SHALL
medicare_advantage.note: The Benefit Plan Standard schema 1.2.0 has no combined slot. The PBP importer spec (section 9.1) proposes accumulators.combined_deductible and accumulators.combined_oop_max.

items.name: Provider directory link
items.meaning: Where the member looks up the providers in the plan's network.

medicare_advantage.label: SHALL
medicare_advantage.note: Section A gives 1 address per plan, written on the in-network tier when it is a URI with its scheme (1,585 of the 6,872 plans in contract year 2027); otherwise the address is quoted in source_references, and the Medicare Advantage importer adds no scheme. pbp_a_phys_web_addr is blank on 127 plans.

marketplace.label: SHALL
marketplace.note: The plan's row of the Network PUF is the one whose BusinessYear, StateCode, IssuerId, NetworkId and MarketCoverage are the plan's; NetworkId alone is used by more than 1 issuer. Every medical plan variant of plan year 2026 has its row, with an address that is a URI (20,670).

items.name: Cost in the second in-network tier
items.meaning: What the member pays at the plan's second tier of in-network providers, for plans that have one.

medicare_advantage.not_in_file: The PBP files have no second in-network tier. They carry facility cost tiers for inpatient and skilled nursing stays only, which the Medicare Advantage importer writes as cost_designation tiers such as IN_1A_TIER_1 and IN_2_TIER_1.

marketplace.label: SHALL
marketplace.note: IN2 is written only when at least 1 of the plan's benefit rows has a tier 2 value. MultipleInNetworkTiers is quoted in source_references and does not decide it.

items.name: Second-tier deductible and maximum
items.meaning: The deductible and out-of-pocket maximum that apply in the second in-network tier.

marketplace.label: SHALL
marketplace.note: The Benefit Plan Standard schema 1.2.0 has deductible and maximum slots for in network and out of network only.

items.name: Coverage outside the service area or the country
items.meaning: Whether the plan covers care away from its service area or abroad.

marketplace.label: SHALL
marketplace.note: Each description is quoted when it is filled. On the 2 UHC examples, whose OutOfCountryCoverage is No, OutOfCountryCoverageDescription is blank.

items.meaning: The member's in-network cost for a primary care office visit.

marketplace.label: SHALL
marketplace.name: Primary care visit
marketplace.benefit_name: Primary Care Visit to Treat an Injury or Illness

items.meaning: The member's in-network cost for a specialist office visit.
The member's in-network cost for urgent care.
The member's in-network cost for an emergency room visit.
The member's in-network cost for an inpatient hospital stay.
The member's in-network cost for outpatient hospital services.
items.note: The PBP crosswalk writes category 9a1 under the broad key outpatient_surgery; observation (9a2) and surgery centers (9b) have their own keys.

items.meaning: The member's in-network cost for the facility where outpatient surgery is done.

marketplace.label: SHALL
marketplace.name: Outpatient surgery center or facility
marketplace.benefit_name: Outpatient Facility Fee (e.g., Ambulatory Surgery Center)

items.meaning: The member's in-network cost for the surgeon's and other doctors' fees for outpatient surgery.
The member's in-network cost for lab tests.
The member's in-network cost for advanced imaging such as MRI, CT or PET.

medicare_advantage.label: SHALL
medicare_advantage.name: Diagnostic radiology (for example MRI or CT)

items.meaning: The member's in-network cost for physical therapy and speech-language therapy, which the PBP prices together.
The member's in-network cost for physical therapy and occupational therapy, which the Marketplace file prices together.

marketplace.label: SHALL
marketplace.name: Physical therapy and occupational therapy
marketplace.benefit_name: Rehabilitative Occupational and Rehabilitative Physical Therapy

items.meaning: The member's in-network cost for an individual session with a mental health professional.
The member's in-network cost for outpatient mental and behavioral health services.
The member's in-network cost for an ambulance.
The member's in-network cost for observation services in a hospital.
The member's in-network cost for an office visit with a nurse practitioner or physician assistant.

marketplace.label: SHALL
marketplace.name: Nurse or physician assistant visit
marketplace.benefit_name: Other Practitioner Office Visit (Nurse, Physician Assistant)

items.meaning: The member's in-network cost for a skilled nursing facility stay.
The member's in-network cost for home health care.
The member's in-network cost for preventive services.

medicare_advantage.label: SHALL
medicare_advantage.name: Preventive services
medicare_advantage.note: Category 14a has no copay or coinsurance column. The plan attests in pbp_b14a_mc_prevent_attest that the Original Medicare zero dollar preventive services cost nothing in network, which the Medicare Advantage importer writes as a $0 copay that does not apply to the deductible. Out of network and at the point of service, the cost comes from the Section C groups that list 14a.

marketplace.label: SHALL
marketplace.name: Preventive services
marketplace.note: The item is the tier 1 cost the file gives, read like any other service. $0 in network is the Medicare Advantage reading, from the plan's attestation.

items.meaning: The member's in-network cost for a visit by phone or video.

medicare_advantage.label: SHOULD
medicare_advantage.name: Telehealth
medicare_advantage.note: Category 7j, additional telehealth benefits, is outside the PBP crosswalk and not written today.

marketplace.not_in_file: No BenefitName in the plan year 2026 file is for this benefit; the crosswalk lists all of the file's names.
No BenefitName in the plan year 2026 file is for this benefit; the crosswalk lists all of the file's names.
